headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United eye move for Calvert-Lewin in January
description: Leeds United striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin is being considered by Manchester United. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso: 'No discussion' over Estêvão loan move
description: Xabi Alonso has said there have been "no discussions" about sending Estêvão on loan despite the Brazil star's limited minutes this term.

headline: Arteta explains reaction to Dowman red card
description: Arteta explains reaction to Dowman red card

headline: Mikel Arteta warning to Max Dowman after red card: 'We are not in Disneyland'
description: Mikel Arteta has said Arsenal are "very disappointed" after their appeal over Max Dowman's red card at Fleetwood Town was dismissed but warned the teenager must adapt to top level football because "otherwise we are in Disneyland."

headline: James Maddison available for Tottenham's clash with Crystal Palace
description: Tottenham playmaker James Maddison is available for Saturday's visit of Crystal Palace despite an injury scare during the victory at Chelsea.

headline: Youri Tielemans backs Michael Carrick at Man United: 'We don't want a big change'
description: Youri Tielemans insisted the Manchester United squad were happy for Michael Carrick to stay as manager amid the club's worst run since 2015.
